summary: L-4 cab built 1933 on Little Baldy Peak, Gifford Pinchot NF, Skamania County, WA; gone, removal date not found; drive-up to a short walk.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the cab is gone; Willhite has a photo captioned 'Footings of the cab'.

access.note: Willhite: forest road from Willard, 'Access: Good for any vehicle'; no closure appears in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Park just below the summit at the switchback; the site is a short walk on an overgrown trail to the south (Willhite)

events.note: L-4 cab on the south end of the ridge
Panoramic images taken from the cab roof on August 16, 1936 show a road to the site
Osmar Ladiges named as the lookout in 1938
Willhite says the cab was likely no longer used by 1957, when the DNR built Nester Peak Lookout nearby
Registered June 24, 2012 as US 1326, WA 226; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: Willhite describes a drive-up forest road and says 'Access: Good for any vehicle'; no restriction is stated.

notes_for_editor: Built year and L-4 design agree across the register, firelookout.com and Willhite. The removal date is not in any source read, so no removal event is recorded. Staffing is one name (1938); no fire history was found. Willhite's page notes that panoramic images of a different Little Baldy exist in Yacolt State Forest; those were not used. A Facebook post surfaced in search (Mill-A Volunteers, built 1933, now gone) but was not read and is not cited. Access 'public' is inferred from Willhite's drive-up directions with no closure noted; a current Gifford Pinchot check would confirm it.
